summary: Master Solid Waste Management Law. Learn Basel Convention, EPR, and ISO 14001 compliance. Gain practical skills for waste audits and WMP design.
lede: Waste management regulation training covers the rules and processes organizations use to classify waste, plan its handling, and document disposal. It is for environmental compliance managers, waste operations supervisors, auditors, and other professionals responsible for waste outcomes, and develops practical skills in characterizing waste streams, preparing waste management plans, tracking manifests, and auditing site compliance.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level course is tailored for professionals who carry operational or strategic responsibility for environmental outcomes and legal adherence within their organizations.
modules: Regulatory Foundations and the Waste Hierarchy
Waste Management Planning and Digital Tracking
Hazardous Waste Governance and Risk Mitigation
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of environmental management systems or at least one year of experience in an HSE, facility management, or compliance-related role. Familiarity with ISO 14001 is beneficial but not mandatory.
